headline: DeVonta Smith listed as limited in Eagles practice, Saquon Barkley still out
summary: The Eagles announced on Thursday that quarterback Jalen Hurts will not play against the Panthers due to a blood clot in his calf, which leaves Tanner McKee in line to make the first non-Week 18 start of his career.

headline: Jayden Daniels addresses teammates on gaffe, vows 'it'll never happen again'
summary: Jayden Daniels addressed his Commanders teammates, once more blaming himself for the end-of-overtime debacle against the Giants and vowing it won't happen again.

headline: Panthers to visit an Eagles team that was already reeling before losing Hurts to a blood clot
summary: — The Carolina Panthers had already been installed as road betting favorites as they prepare to visit Philadelphia and face a banged-up Eagles team riding a three-game losing streak.

headline: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield To Miss 3rd Straight Game
summary: Original predictions that Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield would miss at least three weeks after dislocating his right thumb have turned out to be accurate.
